info.name: Skyrict Backend
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Skyrict platform backend.

Covers three surfaces:
1. **Identity Service** (FastAPI) - http://localhost:8000/api/v1
2. **Core Service** (FastAPI) - http://localhost:8001/api/v1
3. **Web BFF** (Next.js) - http://localhost:3000

## Auth model
- Most protected endpoints accept `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`.
- Identity and core services route tenants via the `X-Tenant-Slug` header (must match the JWT's tenant).
- Identity enforces a mandatory-MFA gate on `get_current_user` routes (403 MFARequiredError) EXCEPT `/mfa/setup` and `/mfa/verify`.
- The BFF manages the refresh token in an httpOnly `skyrict_session` cookie (auto-handled by Postman's cookie jar).
- BFF state-changing methods require an `Origin` header matching the Host (already set on those requests).

## Flow tip
Run **Identity > Auth > Login** (or **Web BFF > Auth > Login**) first - it stores the access/refresh tokens into collection variables via test scripts. Then set `tenant_slug` and use the path-param variables (`role_id`, `invoice_id`, ...) that the API returns.

## Notes
- `/passkeys/*` and `/sso/*` are registered but return 501 (not yet implemented).
- Finance permission keys: `erp.finance.read`, `erp.finance.write`, `erp.finance.approve`.
- Standard account codes: AR=1100, Cash=1200, AP=2110, Revenue=4000.
- Every direct identity request that requires tenant context already sends `X-Tenant-Slug: {{tenant_slug}}` (populated from the collection variable). Login and Login MFA Verify store the issued tokens into collection variables automatically.

item.name: Identity Service
item.description: FastAPI auth + account service. Base: http://localhost:8000/api/v1

request.description: Authenticate and receive access + refresh tokens. May return next_step "mfa.verify" (with mfa_token) or "mfa.setup". Test script stores tokens.
Redeem the login mfa_token with a TOTP or backup code to receive the final token pair.
Exchange a refresh token for a fresh pair (identity ROTATES the refresh token). Test script stores the new access_token + refresh_token into collection variables.
Revoke the current session. Omit refresh_token to revoke all sessions.
Return token claims if the refresh token is active.

item.name: Signup Wizard
item.description: Multi-step onboarding: gate → OTP → password → organization provisioning. Request bodies use camelCase.

request.description: Send a 6-digit OTP. Dev/test responses include the plaintext code.
Check the OTP; returns a single-use verification_token.
Text CAPTCHA challenge. `answer` is exposed in test only.
Set the wizard password (min 12 chars) bound to the verification token.
Final wizard step: provisions tenant + roles + verified owner. MFA setup becomes mandatory.

item.description: Role CRUD requires roles:write / roles:read permission. Permission catalog is public.

item.name: Invitations
item.description: List/create/expire require the INVITATIONS_SEND permission. Accept is public.

request.description: Plaintext invite token is shown once in the response.

item.name: MFA
item.description: setup/verify are MFA-exempt. backup-codes, disable, reset require full auth.

request.description: Returns secret, otpauth:// URI, and 10 one-time backup codes.
Verify a TOTP or backup code to enable MFA.
Owner-assisted reset of a locked-out user's MFA (requires mfa:manage).

item.name: Web BFF
item.description: Next.js BFF. Base: http://localhost:3000. Refresh token lives in the httpOnly skyrict_session cookie (Postman cookie jar handles it). State-changing methods include the Origin header required by the CSRF gate.

request.description: Sets the session cookie; returns {status, accessToken, user}. Test script stores the access token.
Redeem login MFA challenge and complete session setup.
Restore session from cookie: returns {authenticated, accessToken, expiresIn, user}.
Silent refresh using the httpOnly cookie. Test script stores the fresh accessToken into collection variables.
Requires the Bearer access token in the Authorization header.
Enrollment confirmation - requires Bearer token.
Requires Bearer token.

Redeem token, refresh session, and 303-redirect to the workspace origin.

item.name: Generic Proxy
item.description: Catch-all authenticated proxy: /api/v1/{service}/{path} forwards to identity (8000), except crm/sales/inventory segments which forward to core (8001). Bearer token forwarded from Authorization header; tenant slug derived server-side from the Host header. Mutating methods require an Origin header.

request.description: Example: forward to identity /users/me. Uses the Bearer access token + skyrict_session cookie.
Example: forward to core finance. First path segment determines the target: identity by default, core for crm/sales/inventory.
Example: forward to identity /sessions/{id}.
